title: Unveiling critical structural features for effective HDAC8 inhibition: a comprehensive study using quantitative read-across structure-activity relationship (q-RASAR) and pharmacophore modeling.
authors: Khatun, Samima; Dasgupta, Indrasis; Islam, Rakibul; Amin, Sk Abdul; Jha, Tarun; Dhaked, Devendra Kumar; Gayen, Shovanlal
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦HDAC8酶小分子抑制剂的结构-活性关系建模与药效团设计，对象为蛋白质-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法上MD/对接可部分借鉴，与课题关联度低。
abstract: Histone deacetylases constitute a group of enzymes that participate in several biological processes. Notably, inhibiting HDAC8 has become a therapeutic strategy for various diseases. The current inhibitors for HDAC8 lack selectivity and target multiple HDACs. Consequently, there is a growing recognition of the need for selective HDAC8 inhibitors to enhance the effectiveness of therapeutic interventions. In our current study, we have utilized a multi-faceted approach, including Quantitative Structure-Activity Relationship (QSAR) combined with Quantitative Read-Across Structure-Activity Relationship (q-RASAR) modeling, pharmacophore mapping, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. The developed q-RASAR model has a high statistical significance and predictive ability (Q(2)(F1):0.778, Q(2)(F2):0.775). The contributions of important descriptors are discussed in detail to gain insight into the crucial structural features in HDAC8 inhibition. The best pharmacophore hypothesis exhibits a high regression coefficient (0.969) and a low root mean square deviation (0.944), highlighting the importance of correctly orienting hydrogen bond acceptor (HBA), ring aromatic (RA), and zinc-binding group (ZBG) features in designing potent HDAC8 inhibitors. To confirm the results of q-RASAR and pharmacophore mapping, molecular docking analysis of the five potent compounds (44, 54, 82, 102, and 118) was performed to gain further insights into these structural features crucial for interaction with the HDAC8 enzyme. Lastly, MD simulation studies of the most active compound (54, mapped correctly with the pharmacophore hypothesis) and the least active compound (34, mapped poorly with the pharmacophore hypothesis) were carried out to validate the observations of the studies above. This study not only refines our understanding of essential structural features for HDAC8 inhibition but also provides a robust framework for the rational design of novel selective HDAC8 inhibitors which may offer insights to medicinal chemists and researchers engaged in the development of HDAC8-targeted therapeutics.
abstract_zh: 组蛋白去乙酰化酶构成一组参与多种生物过程的酶。值得注意的是，抑制HDAC8已成为多种疾病的治疗策略。目前针对HDAC8的抑制剂缺乏选择性，并靶向多种HDAC。因此，人们日益认识到需要选择性HDAC8抑制剂以增强治疗干预的有效性。在本研究中，我们采用了多方面的方法，包括定量构效关系 (Quantitative Structure-Activity Relationship, QSAR) 结合定量交叉结构-活性关系 (Quantitative Read-Across Structure-Activity Relationship, q-RASAR) 建模、药效团映射、分子对接和分子动力学 (molecular dynamics, MD) 模拟。所开发的q-RASAR模型具有较高的统计显著性和预测能力（Q(2)(F1):0.778, Q(2)(F2):0.775）。详细讨论了重要描述符的贡献，以深入了解HDAC8抑制中的关键结构特征。最佳药效团假设表现出高回归系数（0.969）和低均方根偏差（0.944），强调了在设计中正确取向氢键受体 (hydrogen bond acceptor, HBA)、芳香环 (ring aromatic, RA) 和锌结合基团 (zinc-binding group, ZBG) 特征对于设计强效HDAC8抑制剂的重要性。为确认q-RASAR和药效团映射的结果，对五种强效化合物（44、54、82、102和118）进行了分子对接分析，以进一步深入了解这些对与HDAC8酶相互作用至关重要的结构特征。最后，对最具活性的化合物（54，与药效团假设正确映射）和最不具活性的化合物（34，与药效团假设映射不佳）进行了MD模拟研究，以验证上述观察结果。本研究不仅深化了我们对HDAC8抑制所需关键结构特征的理解，还为合理设计新型选择性HDAC8抑制剂提供了稳健框架，这可能为从事HDAC8靶向治疗开发的药物化学家和研究人员提供见解。
